_comment: One-click models. Pumpkin checks each repo on Hugging Face when the page opens and hides any that are gone, then picks the best quant that fits the machine. Pull requests to add or update models are welcome.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.blurb: Fast all-round agent. Mixture-of-experts, so it stays quick even when part of it sits in RAM.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.blurb: Smarter dense model for harder questions. Best with 16 GB of VRAM or more.

models.name: gpt-oss 20B
models.blurb: OpenAI's open-weight model. Good at tool use and runs well on 16 GB GPUs.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B
models.blurb: Google's mid-size model that can also look at images. Comfortable on 12 GB GPUs.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct
models.blurb: Small and quick. Runs on almost any GPU, even 6 GB, and on CPUs.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B
models.blurb: Tiny model that understands images. Good first test on any machine.
